A letter from a friend
Hey!
I found something I thought you might like. No idea if it’ll be your thing, but it felt wrong not to send it your way. There’s a little something tucked inside this envelope: a few surprises, some good for a laugh, and maybe a couple that’ll get you out of trouble when things don’t go quite as planned. Open it when you get the chance.
A letter from a lover
My dearest,
I have left something here for you, small enough to hide within these pages. Within this envelope lie a few precious faces, each carrying a little of the grace, charm, and wonder I see whenever I look upon you. I hope that they remind you that some things are worth keeping close to the heart. Your one and only.
A letter from a stranger
To thee who hast found this letter,
I bid thee heed what lieth sealed within. I have enclosed a curious gathering, fashioned for those who know that fortune oft favoureth neither the wise nor the righteous. Therein dwell figures of uncertain purpose, bearing smiles that may conceal more than they reveal. Take what is offered, shouldst thou possess the courage.

HEXTALE PLAYTEST AGREEMENT

By selecting “I Agree”, you agree to the following terms:

1. Playtest Purpose

You are being given access to a pre-release version of Hextale for testing and evaluation purposes.

2. No Copying or Imitation

You agree not to use anything you learn, see, or experience through the Hextale playtest to:

  • copy or recreate Hextale;
  • imitate Hextale or its distinctive combination of original elements;
  • create a game or product that is substantially derived from Hextale; or
  • assist anyone else in doing any of the above.

This applies to Hextale's original game design, systems, mechanics, rules, cards, abilities, characters, artwork, lore, content, and other distinctive elements learned through the playtest.

3. Independent Development

Nothing in this Agreement prevents you from creating or working on your own games or products independently.

You may use general game-development knowledge, skills, and ideas that you developed independently and without using Hextale as the basis for your work.

4. Intellectual Property

Hextale and all of its intellectual property remain the property of Hextale or its respective licensors.

Your participation in the playtest does not grant you any ownership or rights in Hextale.

5. Acceptance

By selecting “I Agree”, you confirm that:

  • you have read and understood this Agreement;
  • you agree to be bound by its terms; and
  • you agree not to copy, recreate, or substantially imitate Hextale based on your participation in the playtest.
